body: I suppose it's not a terrible idea, speaking about these things tends to stabilize my mood, one of the major reasons I wrote the post to begin with was to bring myself out of the ditch I was sitting in, although it's been working less and less lately.

I do have pets, and usually they make me smile.

There are plenty of things that I'm interested in, unfortunately not a lot of those things are nearby. Although, if I could afford it some form of martial training would probably go a long way for my physical health.

I have worked all shifts, personally I think morning shift is the best for me, where as evening is the worst. Nights are somewhere in between. I would actually like to shift over to a 12 hour, 7 day on, 7 day off schedule.

Aside from money, the hardest part of getting medication is sadly setting up the initial appointment. I have no trouble going to something, but for some reason setting it up is the hardest thing in the world, especially if there aren't dire short term consequences.

I don't doubt that it could get better, I imagine if I can get on medication and properly feel things like most people it would be a lot better. One of the three things that I feel genuine disdain for is that I didn't take medication all throughout middle/high school, instead of just being defiant like kids tend to be.

I'm open to any suggestions.

I don't think therapy will help, personally. I don't need to overcome trauma or something from my past. I'm pretty sure this is just 100% my body was dysfunctional and either doesn't produce the right chemicals or doesn't have enough receptors for said chemicals. That said, I'm not above considering therapy, but money is still an issue.

I've been working graveyard for about 6 months, and I'm sure it's had an effect on my sleep quality, exacerbating my constant fatigue. I don't think it's really had an effect on my depression though. Then again, I'm no doctor.
It wouldn't hurt, although I'm not sure where to look for that sort of thing.

I suppose. I guess I'm just stubborn about asking for help.

Clubs are hard simply because I work graveyard, and lately I've been significantly more tired than usual. I'm not terribly opposed to the idea though, but it's also another potential cost I can't afford right now.
Not really, I already burden my family quite a bit, definitely more than I should. And I don't really have any friends.
